text: cmon lets pull it together a bit more, there are a TON of shitty ux approaches in this part of the ui that need real love. everything that has a number and is incremented with + and - is a fucking pain in the ass
resolution: Reworked the shared workbench numeric field renderer so numbers are no longer tiny plus/minus steppers. Every FieldSpec num now renders as a direct numeric text input with snapping/clamping plus a drag scrubber for broad changes, and the material compose CANVAS/NODE PROPERTIES group uses row layout so x/y/w/h/radius/border controls have enough room to be usable.
